title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Multilingual Abstractive Summarization: A Comprehensive Study of English and Bengali
abstract: arXiv:2610.19003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Abstractive summarization remains challenging across languages, where linguistic quality and factual consistency may diverge, particularly in low-resource settings. We present a standardized zero-shot benchmark of eight closed-source and open-weight LLMs on size-matched English and Bengali XL-Sum test sets. Our evaluation combines lexical and semantic metrics with reference-free factuality verification and multidimensional LLM-as-a-Judge assessment, providing a comprehensive analysis of both surface-level quality and factual reliability in multilingual summarization. Results reveal substantial cross-lingual variation: GPT-5.6 Luna leads several English lexical metrics but does not maintain the same advantage in Bengali, where LLaMA 3.3 70B achieves the highest ROUGE and BLEU scores. translated_title: 评估大型语言模型的多语言抽象式摘要能力：英语与孟加拉语的全面研究
translated_abstract: 抽象式摘要在各语言中仍然具有挑战性，其语言质量与事实一致性可能出现分歧，尤其是在低资源环境中。我们提出了一个标准化的零样本基准，对八个闭源和开放权重的大语言模型在规模匹配的英语和孟加拉语 XL-Sum 测试集上进行评估。我们的评估将词汇和语义指标与无参考事实性验证以及多维度的“LLM作为评审”（LLM-as-a-Judge）评估相结合，对多语言摘要的表层质量和事实可靠性进行了全面分析。结果显示出显著的跨语言差异：GPT-5.6 Luna 在多项英语词汇指标上领先，但在孟加拉语中并未保持同样的优势，在孟加拉语中 LLaMA 3.3 70B 取得了最高的 ROUGE 和 BLEU 分数。Gemini 2.5 Flash 获得了所观察到的最高孟加拉语事实性分数。此外，不同的评估方法会产生不同的模型排名，凸显了……
tldr: 该研究构建了一个标准化零样本基准，综合词汇、语义、事实性和LLM评审等多维指标，全面评估了八个大语言模型在英语和孟加拉语摘要任务上的表现，揭示了显著的跨语言性能差异，且不同评估方法会得出不同的模型排名。
en_tdlr: This study presents a standardized zero-shot benchmark evaluating eight LLMs on English and Bengali abstractive summarization with multi-dimensional metrics, revealing substantial cross-lingual performance variation and that different evaluation methods yield different model rankings.
